page.title: Roles & Permissions
page.subtitle: Role matrix and user assignments. Authorization is enforced server-side; changes apply on next sign-in.

role.label: Role
role.empty: No roles yet. Create the first one below.

systemLocked.title: System role is immutable
systemLocked.body: System Manager bypasses every permission check and owns no permission rows, so there is nothing to edit. Any update attempt is rejected with SYSTEM_MANAGER_IMMUTABLE (403).

activeUsersWarning: Warning: {{count}} active user(s) hold this role. Saved changes apply on their next sign-in.
nextLoginNotice: Saved. Permission claims are issued at login (24h expiry), so every affected user sees the new matrix on their next sign-in.

matrix.title: Permission matrix
matrix.subtitle: Rows are document types grouped by module; columns are actions.
matrix.confirmBody: This rewrites the permission matrix for role “{{role}}”. Users holding this role keep their current claims until their next sign-in.

users.title: Users & roles
users.subtitle: Tick roles to assign them. Removing System Manager from the last administrator is rejected (409 CANNOT_REMOVE_LAST_ADMIN).

userModal.title: Roles for {{email}}
userModal.subtitle: Changes apply on the user's next sign-in.
userModal.lastAdmin: Refused: this is the last administrator holding System Manager. Assign the role to someone else first (CANNOT_REMOVE_LAST_ADMIN).
